names.legendary: Count Bellows of the Promenade

lore.common: Wheezes softly whenever it is picked up, as if it is clearing its throat.
lore.uncommon: Plays the same jolly tune whether the mood is happy, sad or a bit awkward.
lore.rare: Squeezes out a polka so catchy that anyone nearby starts hopping on the spot.
lore.epic: Started a dance at the street fair that went round three streets and back to the cake stall.
lore.legendary: Played the town's harbour festival from noon to midnight and never ran out of breath once.

names.legendary: The Stand That Never Dropped a Page

lore.common: Holds the music at just the right height, until somebody touches the wing nut.
lore.uncommon: Sinks slowly lower during every practice until the player is reading from their knees.
lore.rare: Turns the page by itself in a draught, always at the hardest bar of the piece.
lore.epic: Collapsed mid-recital and showered the front row in sheet music, and the audience clapped anyway.
lore.legendary: Held the music for a hundred concerts without dropping a single page, even during the cymbal crash.

names.legendary: The Score That Played Itself

lore.common: Is covered in tiny black notes that look like ants marching across a fence.
lore.uncommon: Has a coffee ring right over the trickiest bar, so nobody can read it.
lore.rare: Slips off the stand at the worst moment, so the player has to play from memory.
lore.epic: Blew out of the window during practice, and the neighbours hummed the tune all week.
lore.legendary: Was so beautifully written that a pianist sat down and played it perfectly the first time they saw it.

names.legendary: The Box That Played One Song Forever

lore.common: Plays a tiny tinkling tune while a little dancer turns on top.
lore.uncommon: Winds down in the middle of the last note, which is quite annoying.
lore.rare: Plays its tune so sweetly that anyone listening forgets what they were angry about.
lore.epic: Was wound up at a birthday party, and the whole room went quiet to hear it.
lore.legendary: Has played the same song every night for sixty years, and it still sounds brand new.

names.legendary: The Metronome That Never Missed a Beat

lore.common: Ticks back and forth at a steady pace, judging every note it hears.
lore.uncommon: Speeds up slightly whenever the player is about to get the hard part right.
lore.rare: Ticks so loudly that the player plays in time even when they don't want to.
lore.epic: Kept a whole school orchestra so perfectly in time that the conductor sat down and let it lead.
lore.legendary: Has ticked so steadily for fifty years that the clocks in the house check their time against it.

names.legendary: The Clock That Kept the Band in Time

lore.common: Ticks in time with music and also happens to tell the time.
lore.uncommon: Chimes at the top of every hour, right in the middle of a quiet piece.
lore.rare: Ticks so loudly that every clock in the room starts ticking at the same speed.
lore.epic: Kept time for the whole marching band one Saturday, and nobody went the wrong way round the park.
lore.legendary: Has kept the beat for so many rehearsals that the band refuses to play without it in the room.

names.legendary: The Bongos That Started Every Party

lore.common: Sits between the knees and goes bop-bop whenever hands come near.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone in the room tap their fingers on the table without thinking.
lore.rare: Plays a rhythm so catchy that the cat starts walking in time.
lore.epic: Started a beach party in the middle of a rainy afternoon, and the sun came out to listen.
lore.legendary: Has started so many parties that people check if it is coming before they accept the invitation.

names.legendary: The Box That Played a Whole Band

lore.common: Looks like a plain wooden box until somebody sits on it and starts slapping.
lore.uncommon: Gets used as a stool by everyone who doesn't know it is a drum.
lore.rare: Thumps so deeply that the floorboards shake along with every beat.
lore.epic: Played the whole drum part at a campfire singalong, and the sausages bounced in the pan.
lore.legendary: Played so many parts at once that the audience thought a whole band was hiding behind it.

names.legendary: The Conga That Led the Parade

lore.common: Stands tall on the floor and makes a deep warm thump when hit.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone nearby want to form a line and wiggle across the room.
lore.rare: Pounds so loudly that every glass on the table hops in time.
lore.epic: Led a carnival line round the whole town square, and the mayor joined at the end.
lore.legendary: Led a parade so long that the front was home for tea before the back had started.

names.legendary: The Drum Heard Across the Valley

lore.common: Is shaped like a big goblet and makes a sharp slap when hit at the edge.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone who sees it want to have a go, even the shy ones.
lore.rare: Pulls the whole room into its rhythm until every foot is tapping.
lore.epic: Drummed so loudly at a school assembly that the hall's windows rattled along.
lore.legendary: Was played so powerfully on a hilltop that the next village started dancing.

names.legendary: Lord Thunderskin the Loud

lore.common: Booms deeply when hit and makes the floorboards vibrate.
lore.uncommon: Gets hit at seven o'clock every Saturday morning by somebody who just got it for their birthday.
lore.rare: Booms so loudly that every dog in the street starts howling along.
lore.epic: Woke the whole street on a Saturday morning, and they all came round to complain and then stayed to dance.
lore.legendary: Played such a mighty solo at a festival that the clouds parted to listen.

names.legendary: The Drum That Ended Every Symphony

lore.common: Sits at the back of the orchestra like a giant copper bowl waiting for its moment.
lore.uncommon: Rumbles so low that it is felt in the stomach before it is heard.
lore.rare: Booms so loudly in the finale that the front row grips their seats.
lore.epic: Played the finale so hard that the conductor's hair stood straight up.
lore.legendary: Has ended so many symphonies with a boom that audiences start clapping the moment it is lifted.

names.legendary: The Drum That Woke the Whole House

lore.common: Goes tap-tap-tap with two tiny sticks and a lot of enthusiasm.
lore.uncommon: Gets played most loudly at the exact moment the baby falls asleep.
lore.rare: Turns any small child into a marching band of one, round and round the kitchen.
lore.epic: Was played on a long car journey, and the whole family learned to sing very loudly.
lore.legendary: Woke the whole house at dawn on a birthday, and nobody minded because of the cake.

names.legendary: The Bass Taller Than Its Player

lore.common: Stands taller than its player and hums so low that it sounds like a sleepy bear.
lore.uncommon: Needs its own seat on the bus, which makes everyone stare.
lore.rare: Plays such a low note that the fruit bowl starts to shake.
lore.epic: Played a jazz club so smoothly that the audience swayed for an hour without noticing.
lore.legendary: Is so tall and grand that one player climbed a stepladder to tune it before a concert.

names.legendary: The Bass That Shook the Venue

lore.common: Has four thick strings and a habit of making everything sound groovier.
lore.uncommon: Rattles the windows of the garage whenever the amplifier is turned up.
lore.rare: Plays a groove so deep that the drummer forgets to count.
lore.epic: Thumped so hard at the school battle of the bands that the trophies jumped on their shelf.
lore.legendary: Played a bassline so mighty that the whole venue moved one foot to the left.

names.legendary: The Guitar That Played Every Song

lore.common: Sits in the corner with one string slightly out of tune, waiting to be strummed.
lore.uncommon: Snaps a string just before the best bit of every song.
lore.rare: Makes anyone who holds it start strumming the same three chords for an hour.
lore.epic: Played a campfire singalong for so long that the marshmallows ran out before the songs did.
lore.legendary: Has played every request ever shouted at it, including one song a toddler made up on the spot.

names.legendary: The Lute That Played for the King

lore.common: Has a round belly and a bent neck, like it has eaten too much at a feast.
lore.uncommon: Takes so long to tune that the song is over before it is ready.
lore.rare: Plays such a gentle tune that everyone at the table stops chewing to listen.
lore.epic: Played at a medieval fair so beautifully that the knights forgot to joust.
lore.legendary: Played a ballad so lovely that a whole castle of knights put down their swords to listen.

names.legendary: The Mandolin That Wooed a Village

lore.common: Has eight little strings that shimmer when played fast.
lore.uncommon: Sounds like a whole flock of birds when someone strums it too quickly.
lore.rare: Plays such a fast tremble that the audience's teeth start to rattle.
lore.epic: Played a serenade so sweetly on the harbour that the fishing boats came back early.
lore.legendary: Played under a window so charmingly that the whole village came out on their balconies.

names.legendary: The Sitar That Played Through the Night

lore.common: Has a long neck and a round gourd body that hums with sympathetic strings.
lore.uncommon: Keeps humming after it is played, so it never quite goes quiet.
lore.rare: Drones so beautifully that listeners lose track of time completely.
lore.epic: Played an evening so hypnotic that the whole audience missed the last bus home.
lore.legendary: Played from sunset to sunrise, and the birds joined in when morning came.

names.legendary: The Harp That Made the River Stop

lore.common: Has so many strings that nobody but its player knows which is which.
lore.uncommon: Needs re-tuning every time the room gets slightly warmer.
lore.rare: Ripples out notes so gently that the whole room drifts into a daydream.
lore.epic: Played so softly at a wedding that the guests forgot to eat the cake.
lore.legendary: Played a tune by the river so beautiful that the water slowed down to listen.

names.legendary: The Mic That Was Never Put Down

lore.common: Gets tapped twice and asked if it is working, every single time.
lore.uncommon: Squeals when anyone walks in front of the speakers.
lore.rare: Makes even the shyest person sing far too loudly once they hold it.
lore.epic: Was grabbed at a karaoke night and not put down until four in the morning.
lore.legendary: Has been sung into by so many people that it can hit every high note on its own.

names.legendary: The Piano That Played Every Wedding

lore.common: Has eighty-eight keys and a lid that bangs shut unexpectedly.
lore.uncommon: Has one key in the middle that sticks, and it is always in the easy song.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who passes play the same two-note tune with one finger.
lore.epic: Hosted a living room concert so good that the neighbours bought tickets for the next one.
lore.legendary: Has played at so many weddings that it plays the first dance tune when anyone opens its lid.

names.legendary: The Instrument Nobody Ever Touched

lore.common: Makes eerie wobbling sounds when hands wave near it without touching.
lore.uncommon: Wails whenever the cat walks past, which frightens the cat every time.
lore.rare: Plays a spooky tune just from somebody stretching their arms nearby.
lore.epic: Gave a school play the spookiest soundtrack ever, and the ghost costume was hardly needed.
lore.legendary: Was played so perfectly that the whole hall gasped, and nobody saw the player touch a thing.

names.legendary: The Toy Piano That Played a Symphony

lore.common: Has twelve tiny keys that make a sweet plinking sound.
lore.uncommon: Has one key that plays a note completely different from the others.
lore.rare: Turns any toddler into a concert pianist for exactly five minutes.
lore.epic: Played a nursery recital so loudly that the parents clapped in self-defence.
lore.legendary: Played a symphony so well that the grand piano in the hall felt a little jealous.

names.legendary: The Toy That Played a Perfect Scale

lore.common: Has bright rainbow bars that make a different sound with every tap.
lore.uncommon: Hides one mallet in the toy box and the other in the dog's bed, every single day.
lore.rare: Plays the same three notes so cheerfully that nobody can stop smiling.
lore.epic: Was played so loudly at playgroup that the teachers had to join in.
lore.legendary: Played a perfect scale up and down without a single wrong note, from a two-year-old.

names.legendary: The Bagpipes Heard From the Hills

lore.common: Groans like a startled goose when first filled up.
lore.uncommon: Takes a whole minute of wheezing before it plays a proper note.
lore.rare: Plays so loudly that every dog in the glen howls along.
lore.epic: Played a whole highland morning so loudly that the sheep lined up in neat rows.
lore.legendary: Played so mightily from a hilltop that people three valleys away came out to march.

names.legendary: The Bugle That Woke the Whole Camp

lore.common: Only plays a few notes but plays them very loudly.
lore.uncommon: Blows a wake-up call every morning, even on holidays.
lore.rare: Makes everyone who hears it stand up straight and salute without knowing why.
lore.epic: Woke a whole campsite of scouts at dawn, and they all fell out of their tents.
lore.legendary: Blew a wake-up call so loud that the sun rose ten minutes early.

names.legendary: The Euphonium That Led the Brass Band

lore.common: Is shiny and round and makes a warm, mellow sound like a friendly bear.
lore.uncommon: Lets out a little burp of a note whenever it is put down too quickly.
lore.rare: Plays such a warm sound that everyone in the park leans in to listen.
lore.epic: Played the bandstand on a Sunday so happily that the ducks paddled in rhythm.
lore.legendary: Led a whole brass band through the town, and every window opened to hear it.
